================================================================================
K-SOFTID: open/override used as identifiers
================================================================================

// `open` and `override` are modifier keywords but valid identifiers:
// `private var open = true` (installerx), `open(filename)` (trime),
// `forEach { override -> }` (zhihu-plus-plus).

fun a() { val open = 1; open(2) }

class A : SeekableByteChannel {
    private var open = true
    override fun close() { open = false }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (property_declaration
          (variable_declaration
            (identifier))
          (number_literal))
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (value_arguments
            (value_argument
              (number_literal)))))))
  (class_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (delegation_specifiers
      (delegation_specifier
        (user_type
          (identifier))))
    (class_body
      (property_declaration
        (modifiers
          (visibility_modifier))
        (variable_declaration
          (identifier))
        (identifier))
      (function_declaration
        (modifiers
          (member_modifier))
        name: (identifier)
        (function_value_parameters)
        (function_body
          (block
            (assignment
              left: (identifier)
              right: (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
K-PARENANNO: annotation on a parenthesized function type
================================================================================

// `content: @Composable (() -> Unit)` — installerx/seal composable
// slots. The paren type carries its own type_modifiers.

fun f(content: @Composable (() -> Unit)) {}

================================================================================
K-ARRLIT: empty array literal in an annotation argument
================================================================================

// `indices = []` — Room @Entity (installerx). `[]` is only legal in
// annotation arguments but the grammar's collection_literal required
// at least one element.

@Entity(tableName = "config", indices = [])
data class ConfigEntity(val id: Int)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
K-NEWLINECTOR: primary constructor parameter list on the next line
================================================================================

// `internal class C\n/** doc */\n    (x: Int)` — mlkit, dbflow,
// facebook-android-sdk. The scanner used to emit _semi after the
// class name, ending the declaration before `(`.

internal class D
/** doc */
    (x: Int) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
